resources.string: What Halo can use and share
Today’s data transfers are not verified here
This page controls AI context sharing, not a complete network-traffic audit. Do not interpret the absence of a transfer count as proof that nothing left the phone.
Used only when a remote provider is selected and relevant policies allow context
These switches allow categories of context to be sent to remote inference when applicable. They are not one-time approval prompts.

Halo is designed without a developer-operated AI or sync server. Local features stay on your device. When you choose an online AI, speech or tool service, data goes to that third party under its own privacy and retention rules. A future purchase-verification service may process licensing details only, never your chats, audio, notes or API keys.
